notes.title: Arcane Chaos Full Release
notes.notes:
Arcane Chaos has now left early access and is fully released! 

I'm not sure what all to say here other than I'm thankful to anyone who purchases Arcane Chaos. I know it's not the most unique game nor the most polished but as my first ever game it was quite the learning experience. I plan to take what I've learned to many future projects so you'll be seeing more of my games all too soon.

Now everyone please enjoy the chaos!
